verdict.rationale: Netlify offers deploy previews for reviewing changes before going live and one-click rollback to a previous deploy, which reduce risk around releases, but there is no evidence of true incremental/staged rollout mechanisms like percentage-based traffic splitting or canary releases to limit blast radius. Missing for 10: canary/staged rollout support, percentage-based traffic shifting, gradual rollout automation, and any documentation framing deploys as incremental releases.
